title: Recipe browsing
question: Does compact inspection keep results and actions readable while full reference stays easy to reach?
task: Find a recipe, inspect its ingredient, return, cook once, then inspect the recorded result.
surface: Cooking service, local inspection, expanded reference; You, inventory and Reports stay visible.
fixture: Synthetic stock, access and scripted success. Pinned YAIR recipe definitions, tokens and detail renderer from the retained recipe experiment. No game save access.
limits: Simplified five-region frame, two recipes, no native RNG/XP or production navigation. Visual choice and native integration remain open.

title: Archived launch proposal · superseded
question: Do a separate identity panel, central beginning choices and adjacent summary make a richer start readable?
task: Choose a background and optional system; preview opening, return with Escape, then switch layouts without losing the selection.
surface: Pre-PLAY threshold; identity left, beginning center, summary right; credits below.
fixture: Current native mountNewGameBeginning renderer and UI tokens/CSS. Six original public background fixtures; background effects and opening preview are simulated. No game startup or saves.
limits: Superseded by Weibao: restore the original loading screen, keep it to PLAY, defer a separate start page. This retained study is historical only; its background effects are simulated.
